description: This file contains functions that manage partition checking, formatting, mounting, and upgrade procedures specific to the uDPU device. It includes logic for handling eMMC storage, preparing partitions, and performing firmware updates.

methods.name: udpu_check_emmc
methods.description: Checks for available eMMC device and sets appropriate device path.

methods.name: udpu_part_prep
methods.description: Prepares a partition by unmounting it if necessary.

methods.name: udpu_do_part_check
methods.description: Checks existing partitions and recreates partitions if invalid.

methods.name: udpu_do_misc_prep
methods.description: Prepares the /misc partition, mounting or formatting it as needed.

methods.name: udpu_do_initial_setup
methods.description: Formats and prepares essential partitions for initial setup.

methods.name: udpu_do_regular_upgrade
methods.description: Performs cleaning of /boot and /root partitions before upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_uDPU
methods.description: Main upgrade procedure orchestrating partition preparation and firmware extraction.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_uDPU
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to /misc for restore after reboot.
